name: Integrations visual
purpose: Reassures buyers the platform plugs into their existing tools with a short pitch over a wide integrations strip image.
description: Centred H2 + grey paragraph above a wide 1440:410 integrations strip image (padded 1.5rem), optionally followed by a centred primary button. `variant` changes layout only: 'mid-market' (/lms/corporate-lms; 45.25rem container, button below the container), 'enterprise' (/lms/enterprise; same, no button), 'features' (/lms/features; 60rem container, 6rem spacer, larger 24px paragraph in 42rem, button row under the image).

evidenceNotes: All three pages use the per-variant defaults.
The strip shows third-party integration marks on the original; no closed asset role covers integration-partner logos, so product.screenshot + placeholder.neutral are allowed.

No sample is given for the 'mid-market' variant (/lms/corporate-lms): its default body copy in IntegrationsVisual.jsx names a real third-party chat product, so it cannot be used verbatim as a sample. The copy should be replaced in source; content shape is identical to the other variants (heading, body, ctaLabel 'See all integrations →', media).
